extracted.name: BBQ Meatballs
extracted.description: This easy crockpot BBQ Meatballs recipe could not be more simple with homemade or store-bought meatballs in a simple sauce. They are sweet, tangy, and the ultimate crowd-pleasing appetizer!
ingredient_lines: green onion (, finely chopped for garnish)
instruction_lines: Spray the bottom of your slow cooker lightly with cooking spray. Add frozen meatballs to the bottom of pot.
In a large bowl, stir together cranberry sauce, cocktail sauce, brown sugar, water, and barbecue sauce then pour over meatballs.
Cook on LOW for 4-6 hours or HIGH for 2-3 hours.
Serve warm garnished with chopped green onions, if desired. You could also serve over rice.
